-- Create deduplicated parts catalog - group by name and cas_number, sum quantities
SELECT name, cas_number, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, 
       GROUP_CONCAT(location, ', ') as locations,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lot_id, ' | ') as lot_ids,
       GROUP_CONCAT(notes || ' | ') as notes
FROM reagents
GROUP BY name, cas_number
ORDER BY name, cas_number;

args.query:
-- Create a temporary view with deduplicated parts catalog
CREATE TABLE parts_catalog AS
SELECT 
    name as part_name,
    cas_number as part_number,
    SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(location, '; ') as all_locations,
    GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id, ' | ') as lot_ids,
    GROUP_CONCAT(notes, '; ') as notes
FROM reagents
GROUP BY name, cas_number
ORDER BY part_name;

FROM parts_catalog
ORDER BY part_name;

    SELECT 'part_name|part_number|total_quantity|all_locations|lot_ids|notes' as csv_row
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '"' || part_name || '","' || part_number || '","' || total_quantity || '","' || all_locations || '","' || lot_ids || '","' || COALESCE(notes, '') || '"'
    FROM parts_catalog
)
